en: to twinkle; to glitter; to shine

examples.en: The stars twinkle in the night sky.
After I cleaned, the floor shone.
The glittering marbles are so pretty.
The child's eyes are sparkling.

examples.ko: 새로 산 구두가 반짝반짝해서 기분이 좋아요.
examples.en: My new shoes are shiny, so I feel good.
I wiped the window until it sparkled.

explain: 별이나 보석이 빛나는 모습에도 쓰고, 깨끗이 닦은 바닥이나 유리가 빛나는 모습에도 써요. '별이 반짝반짝 빛나요'처럼 '하다' 없이 부사로도 써요.

phrases.en: I went out wearing shiny shoes.
phrases.nuance_ko: '-ㄴ' 형태로 뒤의 명사를 꾸며요.
phrases.nuance_en: The -ㄴ form modifies the noun that follows.

phrases.en: I wiped the window until it sparkled.
phrases.nuance_ko: 깨끗이 닦아서 빛나게 만든다는 뜻으로 부사처럼 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used adverbially: wipe until it shines.

phrases.en: The lake sparkles in the sunlight.
phrases.nuance_ko: 빛이 잠깐씩 나는 모습을 말하는 같은 뜻의 동사예요.
phrases.nuance_en: A verb with a similar meaning for light flashing on and off.

explain_en: Use it for stars and jewels that twinkle, and also for a floor or glass that shines after cleaning. You can also use '반짝반짝' alone as an adverb: '별이 반짝반짝 빛나요'.

examples.ko: 이 베이지 코트가 저한테 잘 어울려요.
examples.en: This beige coat suits me well.
Beige goes well with any color.
I painted the wall beige, and the room got brighter.
Yesterday I bought a pair of beige pants.
It is a bag mixing white and beige.

examples.ko: 베이지도 좋지만 저는 검은색이 더 편해요.
examples.en: Beige is nice too, but I feel more comfortable in black.

explain: 색 이름은 '베이지색'처럼 '색'을 붙여도 되고, '베이지 코트'처럼 바로 명사 앞에 써도 돼요. '핑크'나 '민트' 같은 외래어 색 이름도 같은 방식으로 써요.

phrases.en: I bought a beige bag.
phrases.nuance_ko: '색'을 붙여 색 이름을 분명하게 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: Adding '색' makes it clearly a color name.

phrases.en: I wore a white T-shirt with beige pants.
phrases.nuance_ko: '색' 없이 바로 명사 앞에 써도 돼요.
phrases.nuance_en: You can also put it right before a noun without '색'.

phrases.en: I like the light beige wallpaper.
phrases.nuance_ko: '연한'을 붙이면 더 밝은 베이지를 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: Adding '연한' means a lighter shade of beige.

explain_en: You can add '색' as in '베이지색', or put it straight before a noun as in '베이지 코트'. Loanword color names like '핑크' and '민트' work the same way.

examples.ko: 분홍 원피스를 입은 아이가 웃고 있어요.
examples.en: The child in a pink dress is smiling.
The petals turned a light pink.
My favorite color is pink.
Pink and white go well together.
Pink gives a soft feeling.

examples.ko: 분홍도 노랑도 봄에 잘 어울리는 색이에요.
examples.en: Both pink and yellow are colors that suit spring.

explain: '분홍색'이라고도 하고 '핑크'라고도 해요. '분홍'만 써도 색 이름으로 통해요. '빨강', '노랑'처럼 '-색' 없이 말하는 색이 더 있어요.

phrases.en: I bought a pink bag.
phrases.nuance_ko: '분홍'과 같은 뜻이고, '-색'을 붙여 일상에서 가장 흔히 쓰는 말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: Same meaning as 분홍; adding -색 is the most common everyday form.

phrases.en: The light pink flowers are really pretty.
phrases.nuance_ko: '연-'은 색이 옅다는 뜻이라서 밝고 부드러운 분홍을 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: 연- means pale, so this is a soft, light pink.

phrases.en: The child's cheeks are pink.
phrases.nuance_ko: '분홍빛'은 분홍색을 띠는 느낌을 말해서 볼, 하늘, 꽃잎에 자주 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Describes a pinkish tint, often for cheeks, sky or petals.

explain_en: You can say 분홍색 or the English loanword 핑크. 분홍 alone works as a color name. Other colors like 빨강 and 노랑 also drop -색 in the same way.

dis.h: short form without the color suffix

p.n: Same meaning; 분홍 is shorter and used mostly before a noun.

en: being reddish; being tinged with red; red

examples.en: The sunset has a slight reddish tint.
When fall came, the maple leaves turned red.

examples.ko: 해가 질 때 하늘에 붉은빛이 번져요.
examples.en: A red glow spreads across the sky when the sun sets.
The red of this lipstick is too strong.
There are days when the moon looks reddish.
I'm tired, so my eyes look a bit red.

explain: '빨간색'은 분명한 색 이름이고, '붉은빛'은 어떤 것에 붉은 기운이 돌거나 비치는 느낌이에요. '붉은빛을 띠다', '붉은빛이 돌다'처럼 함께 자주 써요.

phrases.en: I have a cold, so my face has a reddish tinge.
phrases.nuance_ko: 어떤 것에 붉은 기운이 은은하게 보일 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when a faint red tinge appears on something.

phrases.en: A red sunset glow spread over the sea.
phrases.nuance_ko: 노을이나 하늘처럼 번지는 붉은 느낌에 잘 어울려요.
phrases.nuance_en: Fits spreading red light such as a sunset or sky.

phrases.en: I got red roses as a gift.
phrases.nuance_ko: 색 이름 자체를 말하는 표현으로, '붉은빛'보다 분명한 색이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: Names the color itself and is more definite than 붉은빛.

explain_en: '빨간색' is a clear color name, while '붉은빛' is the feeling of a red tint showing in or on something. It is often used in '붉은빛을 띠다' and '붉은빛이 돌다'.

en: to be refreshing-looking; to be open and unreserved; to be breezy

examples.en: That actor has a bright, open smile.
She has an open, frank personality, so she has many friends.
Thank you for answering so frankly.
That singer's voice was clear and open.
Her wide, open eyes are impressive.

examples.ko: 시원스러울 만큼 큰 창문이 마음에 들어요.
examples.en: I like the window that is so big it feels open and airy.

explain: '시원하다'는 온도·국물·기분에 널리 쓰지만, '시원스럽다'는 사람의 성격·표정·말투가 막힘없이 활짝 열린 느낌일 때 써요. 찬 음료나 바람에는 '시원스럽다'를 쓰지 않아요. 비슷한 말로 '시원시원하다'가 있어요.

phrases.en: My younger sibling laughs openly, which is nice to see.
phrases.nuance_ko: '시원스러운'을 '-게'로 바꾸면 웃음이나 말하는 모습을 꾸며 줘요.
phrases.nuance_en: With '-게' it describes how someone laughs or speaks.

phrases.en: That person seems to have an open, easygoing personality.
phrases.nuance_ko: 처음 본 사람의 인상을 말할 때 '-어 보이다'와 같이 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used with '-어 보이다' to describe a first impression of someone.

phrases.en: That friend speaks in a straightforward, open way.
phrases.nuance_ko: '시원스럽다'와 비슷한데, 말이나 행동이 빠르고 막힘없다는 느낌이 더 커요.
phrases.nuance_en: Similar, but with a stronger sense of quick, unhesitating speech or action.

explain_en: 시원하다 is used widely for temperature, soup, and feelings, but 시원스럽다 describes a person's character, expression, or way of speaking that feels open and unblocked. It is not used for cold drinks or wind. A similar word is 시원시원하다.

dis.h: looks fresh and open; breezy manner

p.n: This word describes manner or looks (open, generous), so the temperature word does not fit here.

examples.en: Reading this book opened a whole new world for me.
As soon as I entered that shop, I fell into a new world.

examples.ko: 새로운 도시에서 완전 다른 신세계가 열렸어요.
examples.en: A completely different new world opened in the new city.
The food I tried for the first time was a revelation.

examples.ko: 신세계 같은 풍경에 말이 안 나왔어요.
examples.en: The scenery was like another world and left me speechless.

examples.ko: 이 앱을 쓰고 나서 신세계에 온 것 같아요.
examples.en: After using this app, I feel like I came to a new world.

explain: '신세계'는 처음 겪는 일에 놀랐을 때 비유로 많이 써요. 같은 소리가 한국 백화점 이름으로도 쓰여요. 옛날에는 아메리카 대륙을 '신세계'라고도 불렀어요.

phrases.en: a total revelation; a whole new world
phrases.nuance_ko: 처음 겪는 좋은 경험에 놀랐을 때 가볍게 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: Said casually when a first-time experience surprises you in a good way.

explain_en: '신세계' is used figuratively when you are amazed by a first-time experience. The same word is also the name of a Korean department store. In the past, the Americas were also called the 'New World'.

examples.ko: 사진 속 아버지의 옆모습이 저랑 닮았어요.
examples.en: My father's profile in the photo looks like mine.
That actor's profile is really handsome.
I drew a side view of my friend sitting by the window.
I can tell who it is just from the profile, even from far away.
I checked my side view in the mirror.
When you smile, your profile is just like Mom's.

explain: '앞모습', '뒷모습'과 같이 외우면 쉬워요. 얼굴만 가리킬 때는 '옆얼굴'이라고도 해요. 사람의 분위기를 말할 때 '뒷모습'처럼 '옆모습'도 많이 써요.

phrases.en: My friend's profile by the window is pretty.
phrases.nuance_ko: 몸 전체가 아니라 얼굴만 옆에서 본 모습을 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: Refers only to the face seen from the side, not the whole body.

phrases.en: I took a photo of my friend's profile.
phrases.nuance_ko: 사진 찍는 상황에서 자주 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Often used when taking photos.

phrases.en: The twins look the same from the front and from the side.
phrases.nuance_ko: 앞모습과 같이 묶어 비교할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Paired with 'apmoseup' when comparing views.

explain_en: Learn it alongside '앞모습' (front view) and '뒷모습' (back view). When you mean just the face, you can say '옆얼굴'. Like '뒷모습', '옆모습' is also used to talk about how a person looks or comes across.

examples.ko: 선생님이 칠판에 오각형을 그려 보라고 하셨어요.
examples.en: The teacher told us to draw a pentagon on the board.
A pentagon has five sides.
This building is a pentagon when seen from above.

examples.ko: 별 안에 작은 오각형이 숨어 있어요.
examples.en: A small pentagon is hidden inside the star.
I learned the differences among triangles, squares and pentagons.
I bought a pentagon-shaped plate.

explain: '삼각형, 사각형, 육각형'처럼 각의 수를 앞에 붙여 만드는 말이에요. 발음은 [오가켱]이에요. 일상에서는 '오각형 모양'이라고도 많이 말해요.

phrases.en: This plate is pentagon-shaped.
phrases.nuance_ko: 물건의 생김새를 말할 때 '모양'을 붙여요.
phrases.nuance_en: Add '모양' (shape) to describe how an object looks.

phrases.en: Try drawing a pentagon with a ruler.
phrases.nuance_ko: 도형을 그릴 때 '그리다'와 함께 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used with '그리다' when drawing a shape.

phrases.en: A pentagon has five sides in total.
phrases.nuance_ko: 도형의 부분을 설명할 때 '의'를 붙여 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Uses '의' to explain a part of the shape.

explain_en: Like '삼각형', '사각형' and '육각형', it is built by putting the number of angles first. It is pronounced [오가켱]. In daily talk people also say '오각형 모양' (pentagon shape).
